title: Galaktoboureko Keto Custard Pie
description: A creamy keto custard pie wrapped in a semolina pastry, perfect for a low-carb dessert.

ingredients.name: Custard filling
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a sugar-free sweetener

ingredients.name: Yellowed Greek cheese
ingredients.notes: grate the cheese for the filling

ingredients.name: Galaktoboureko syrup
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a sugar-free sweetener

ingredients.name: Sugar-free sweetener
ingredients.notes: use to sweeten the custard filling

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: use to grease the pastry crust

instructions: Prepare the semolina pastry crust according to the recipe.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, heavy cream, and sugar-free sweetener.
Add the grated yellowed Greek cheese to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Pour the custard filling into the prepared pastry crust.
Roll out the flaky pastry to fit the top of the pie.
Place the pastry on top of the pie and crimp the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pie with the unsalted butter.
Bake the pie for 40-45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes.
Drizzle the galaktoboureko syrup over the top of the pie.
